description: This file declares the NeedMediaData class, which manages media data requests within the Rialto media server component. It includes dependencies on media pipeline, shared memory, and request handling interfaces, and defines the class's constructor, destructor, and send method, along with private member variables.

classes.name: NeedMediaData
classes.description: A class responsible for handling media data requests, encapsulating the request parameters and managing communication with media pipeline clients.

methods.name: NeedMediaData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media data request with client, request handler, shared memory buffer, session ID, media source type, source ID, and playback state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Method to send the media data request to the media pipeline.
